case_name: SETH-MICHAEL RAYMAN v R&E ELECTRICAL LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Determination heading: Seth-Michael Rayman was not constructively and unjustifiably dismissed by his former employer R&E Electrical Limited. The claim is dismissed.
review_notes: Direct review of the alleged privacy breach, disciplinary process and constructive-dismissal causation. No employer breach caused the resignation.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal remedies; costs reserved.

case_name: ROGER TEAGUE v PYROCLASSIC FIRES LIMITED now PYRO FIRES LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Pyro Fires did not act unjustifiably in reaching its decision that Mr Teague’s position was redundant and dismissing him, but it did disadvantage him in failing to provide sufficient information.
review_notes: Direct review. Redundancy dismissal was justified; a separate information/consultation disadvantage grievance succeeded and is not used to alter dismissal merits.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal remedy; $7,000 compensation for separate disadvantage.

case_name: SOPHY CHO v AIR NEW ZEALAND LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [51] Ms Cho’s claims for unjustified dismissal and unjustified disadvantage are declined.
review_notes: Direct review of the vaccination-order termination and Air New Zealand’s consultation with Ms Cho.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal remedies; costs reserved.

case_name: KATERINA RAUKURA ROPIHA v TE WĀNANGA O AOTEAROA
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: For the avoidance of doubt this determination does not determine or otherwise deal with Ms Ropiha’s personal grievance application.
review_notes: Frivolous/jurisdictional invoice application only. The employment personal grievance was expressly outside this determination.

case_name: KATHERINE HELEN MCINTYRE v NSW
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [77] The Authority is not satisfied that the dismissal was justified. [78] Ms McIntyre has made out her personal grievance of unjustified constructive dismissal.
review_notes: Direct and second source review of workplace bullying/safety, causation and contribution. No contribution was found.
remedies_awarded: $26,465.40 gross lost wages and $30,000 compensation.

case_name: PUYOUNG KWON v TRANQUILITY HEALTH AND SPA LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [42] THS has not sought to justify the dismissal ... Accordingly, the Authority determines that the dismissal was unjustified and Ms Kwon has a personal grievance of that kind.
review_notes: Direct review of disputed resignation/dismissal and remedies.
remedies_awarded: $15,000 compensation and $3,872.61 lost wages plus statutory wage/leave relief and penalty.

case_name: WARD HAWKER v NORTH CANTERBURY REFRIGERATION & ELECTRICAL (2018) LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [81] Ward Hawker was not constructively dismissed but he was unjustifiably disadvantaged while in the employ of North Canterbury Refrigeration & Electrical (2018) Limited.
review_notes: Direct and second source review. Constructive-dismissal grievance failed; separate disadvantage/wage claims succeeded. No contribution to the separate grievance.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal remedy; $20,000 disadvantage compensation and wage relief.

case_name: JONATHAN TWYMAN v CARTER HOLT HARVEY LVL LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [11] Jonathan Twyman is ordered to pay $3,375 in costs to Carter Holt Harvey LVL Limited.
review_notes: Costs-only follow-up after the underlying merits claim. Excluded to avoid treating a costs determination as a separate dismissal case.

case_name: ERIC FORSTER v CAROLE MARSHALL
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: This determination concerns an application to reopen the earlier determination between Eric Forster and Carole Marshall.
review_notes: Reopening/procedural follow-up to the underlying merits decision (2022 NZERA 367); excluded to avoid duplicate merits counting.

case_name: GLENDA REES v PACIFIC RADIOLOGY GROUP LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [38] The grievance should be treated as one of unjustified dismissal. [39] The investigation meeting to hear the substantive matter is set down for 18 and 19 July 2023.
review_notes: Preliminary timeliness/characterisation determination only. Substantive dismissal merits were expressly scheduled for later hearing.

case_name: LILI WANG v GREENTREE NM CATERING LIMITED (t/a MASTER BAO)
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The issue before the Authority is whether there is anything further owed to Ms Wang for wage arrears, working on a public holiday, payment for an alternative day and holiday pay.
review_notes: Current determination is a wage/holiday-pay case. Its reference to an earlier unjustified dismissal concerns a different employer and earlier decision and is not a merits finding here.

case_name: GARTH CUNNINGHAM v HEALTHALLIANCE NZ LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [65] The dismissal of Mr Cunningham was what healthAlliance, acting as a fair and reasonable employer, could have done in all the circumstances. The dismissal was therefore a justified dismissal.
review_notes: Direct and second source review of the disciplinary investigation and prior warnings.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal remedies; no orders against healthAlliance.

case_name: PHILIPPA JOHNSON v CERVIN MEDIA LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [10] Cervin Media was successful in defending all of Ms Johnson’s claims. [11] Ms Johnson is ordered to pay Cervin Media Limited $4,500 as a contribution to its costs.
review_notes: Costs-only determination following an earlier substantive determination; excluded to avoid duplicate counting.

case_name: JANE MAREE COOKSLEY v DOGMAD GROOMERS LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [41] Leave to raise the grievance outside the 90-day period is granted. [43] Costs are reserved pending any investigation and determination of Ms Cooksley’s substantive claims.
review_notes: Leave/timeliness determination only; substantive dismissal merits remained pending.

case_name: ROBERT WHITLEY v FIRSTLIGHT FROZEN LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [63] I find that the termination of Mr Whitley’s employment was justified. Mr Whitley’s claim of unjustified dismissal is not made out.
review_notes: Direct review of vaccination-policy dismissal. Separate garden-leave disadvantage and statutory arrears claims succeeded.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal remedy; separate $10,000 disadvantage compensation plus arrears/penalty.

case_name: MICHAEL FERRIS Senior First v MICHAEL FERRIS Junior Second Applicant AND THE PROPRIETORS OF NUHITI Q
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Alternative redeployment options were never investigated or considered fully and this means I have found the Applicants’ personal grievance has been successful.
review_notes: Direct and second source review of redundancy rationale, consultation and redeployment. Genuine financial reasons existed, but the final proposal was not genuinely considered. No contribution.
remedies_awarded: $20,000 compensation to each applicant plus wage arrears.

case_name: STACEY ROY v CARRINGTON RESORT JADE LP
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The Respondent unjustifiably constructively dismissed Ms Roy from her employment on 30 April 2022.
review_notes: Direct review of constructive dismissal and monetary remedies.
remedies_awarded: $10,783.05 lost remuneration plus dismissal compensation and other amounts.

case_name: VJZ v KJT
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [78] The conduct of this matter will now be handed back to the Presiding Member for investigation of the remaining issues. [82] Costs are reserved ... along with the substantive determination.
review_notes: Privilege/admissibility and interim non-publication determination only; substantive merits remained for the Presiding Member.

case_name: LEON VAN DER PLAS v KIWIRAIL LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [58] Having not obtained a finding of an unjustified dismissal and/or unjustified disadvantage Leonard van der Plas is unsuccessful in his personal grievances.
review_notes: Direct review of constructive-dismissal and workplace-environment allegations.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal remedies; costs reserved.

case_name: JACKIE HARTE v TE WHATU ORA - HEALTH NEW ZEALAND
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Summary of findings and orders: Jackie Harte was unjustifiably disadvantaged in her employment ... Jackie Harte was not constructively dismissed.
review_notes: Direct and second source review. Dismissal grievance failed; separate disadvantage and good-faith claims succeeded.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal remedy; $15,000 disadvantage compensation and $4,000 good-faith penalty.

case_name: ANDREW FLEMING v BAILEY TANKS LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [21] Mr Fleming’s grievance claims were not raised with BTL within the required 90-day period. [22] The Authority is not able to investigate the grievance claims further and determine the merits of them.
review_notes: Timeliness determination only; dismissal merits were expressly not determined.

case_name: LEON THOMPSON v EDWARDS & HARDY HAWKES BAY LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Conclusion: the decision to dismiss Mr Thompson has been justified by E&H and the process that was followed was fair and reasonable in the circumstances.
review_notes: Direct and second source review of dishonesty/serious-misconduct allegations, the earlier warning, suspension and process.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal remedies; costs reserved.

case_name: PETER SLOGGETT v MODERN TRANSPORT ENGINEERS LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [25] Mr Sloggett’s dismissal on 16 June 2022 was unjustified. [26] Mr Sloggett has established a personal grievance for unjustified dismissal.
review_notes: Direct and second source review of alleged serious misconduct involving removal of bottle jacks. Employer process was seriously deficient; s 124 remedies reduced 10% for blameworthy removal of property.
remedies_awarded: $3,653.85 gross lost wages; compensation subject to 10% contribution reduction; employer counterclaim failed.

case_name: RAHID AMIN v HUTT AND CITY TAXIS LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [135] I conclude that the dismissal was both procedurally and substantively unjustified.
review_notes: Direct and second source review. Alleged serious misconduct was not established through a fair or robust process; no s 124 reduction was made because the unfair procedure caused the grievance.
remedies_awarded: $28,500 compensation and $20,696 lost wages.

case_name: JENNIFER-LEE HARLEY v CHIEF OF NEW ZEALAND DEFENCE FORCE
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Conclusion: Ms Harley’s claims fall outside the Authority’s jurisdiction and accordingly it cannot investigate them.
review_notes: NZDF/Defence Act jurisdiction determination only; no dismissal merits were reached.

case_name: SIMARJIT KAUR v KAITERITERI PROPERTIES LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [97] I therefore do not find Ms Kaur should have the remedies for her unjustified dismissal reduced.
review_notes: Direct and second source review of redundancy, consultation and contribution. The dismissal grievance succeeded and no contribution reduction was warranted.
remedies_awarded: Dismissal remedies awarded; costs reserved.

case_name: SUHEE LEE v YAMAYA NZ LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [27] Yamaya is unable to demonstrate its actions were those a fair and reasonable employer could have taken ... The dismissal was unjustified. [28] Ms Lee has established a personal grievance for unjustified dismissal.
review_notes: Direct and second source review. No blameworthy contribution to the dismissal was found.
remedies_awarded: $18,000 compensation; $5,520 gross lost wages; wage/holiday arrears and penalty.

case_name: MICHAEL FERRIS Senior First v MICHAEL FERRIS Junior Second Applicant AND THE PROPRIETORS OF NUHITI Q
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Orders: the Proprietors of Nuhiti Q are to pay costs to Michael Ferris Sr and Michael Ferris Jr in the amount of $10,000 and the filing fee of $71.56.
review_notes: Costs-only follow-up to 2023 NZERA 395; excluded to avoid duplicate merits counting.

case_name: KIM TEPANIA v HAVEN FALLS FUNERAL HOME LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [119] Ms Tepania has established a personal grievance for unjustified dismissal.
review_notes: Direct and second source review of trial-period validity, dismissal, remedies and contribution. No blameworthy contribution found.
remedies_awarded: $18,000 compensation; $4,830 gross lost wages; $386.40 holiday pay.

case_name: JOHN WELTEN v MCKAY LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [39] The parties are directed to attend mediation ... Mr Welten is to advise the Authority ... if he wishes the investigation of his personal grievance to proceed.
review_notes: Preliminary routing/mediation determination; substantive personal-grievance merits remained for later investigation.

case_name: GRACE PATRICIA WAITAPU ASHER First v ROBERT JOHN COLIN GAVIN Second Applicant AND MICHELLE LEE-ANN KNIGHT AND MURRAY NEIL KNIGHT AS TRUSTEES OF THE M N AND M L KNIGHT FAMILY TRUST
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [39] Given my finding that the Applicants did not raise a personal grievance in time in accordance with s 114 of the Act, there are no remedies available to the Applicants under s 123 of the Act.
review_notes: Applicants had resigned and the personal-grievance claims were out of time; the determination principally resolved holiday-pay issues and did not decide dismissal merits.
column18: Holiday-pay issues only; no dismissal-merits remedy.

case_name: ITANIA NIKOLAO v WAIKATO REGIONAL COUNCIL
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [20] This is not an assessment about the strength of Ms Nikolao’s grievance claims. [23] Given that a dismissal grievance has now been added ... the Authority [will later] investigate the employment relationship problem.
review_notes: Application to remove matter to the Employment Court only; no dismissal merits were adjudicated.

case_name: BOMI KIM v BRAK BURNS LIMITED (IN LIQUIDATION)
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [25] Ms Kim has established personal grievances for unjustified disadvantage and unjustified dismissal.
review_notes: Direct and second source review of redundancy, unpaid wages, remedies and contribution. No blameworthy contribution was found.
remedies_awarded: $18,000 compensation; $11,765.75 gross lost wages; wage/holiday arrears, penalty and costs.

case_name: SUHEE LEE v YAMAYA NZ LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Outcome: Yamaya NZ Limited is ordered to pay Suhee Lee costs and to pay the prior awards according to an instalment schedule.
review_notes: Costs/instalment follow-up to 2023 NZERA 572; excluded to avoid duplicate dismissal merits.

case_name: AIDAN SAMUELSON v CODEY HALSE
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [27] Mr Samuelson has established his personal grievance for unjustified constructive dismissal.
review_notes: Direct and second source review of pay reduction, sick-leave non-payment, constructive dismissal and contribution. No contribution reduction warranted.
remedies_awarded: $5,000 compensation; $11,247.20 lost remuneration plus wage/leave arrears.

case_name: MERE FARAIMO v VIRTUOSO STRINGS CHARITABLE TRUST BOARD
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [72] This is a disadvantage grievance, and not a dismissal situation.
review_notes: Direct and second source review. Three related unjustified-disadvantage findings were made, but there was no dismissal case to place in the dismissal-merits denominator.
column18: $10,571.70 wage reimbursement and $25,000 compensation for disadvantage; no dismissal remedy.

case_name: YICAN LIAO v WSL INTERNATIONAL LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [41] WSL International Limited is ordered to pay Yican Liao wage arrears in the amount of $59,890.00 under s 131 of the Employment Relations Act 2000.
review_notes: Wage-arrears determination only; no dismissal grievance was adjudicated.

case_name: SEOJEONG JOO v HOSPITALITY SERVICES LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [135] The Authority concludes that Ms Joo does not have a personal grievance, whether of unjustified disadvantage or unjustified dismissal. [137] No orders are made against HSL.
review_notes: Direct review of alleged bullying, employer responses, mediation offer and constructive-dismissal causation.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal remedies; no orders against HSL.

case_name: NATASHA BROWNE AND MELISSA BROWNE v WAIKATO KINDERGARTEN ASSOCIATION
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [83] Natasha had established a personal grievance of unjustified dismissal for which she was entitled to an assessment of remedies.
review_notes: Direct and second source review. WKA acted unjustifiably in Natasha Browne’s redundancy dismissal; no s 124 contribution reduction was warranted. Melissa Browne’s separate claims did not alter Natasha’s dismissal result.
remedies_awarded: Twenty-six weeks’ wages and compensation for Natasha Browne; other claims addressed separately.
